head: 6d66ea2bb19de2d4826ac454fae56521c8f70cca
title: fix(client-plans): an ended plan can be started again; ending plans never say Renews (MONEY-CLIENT-124)
body:
MONEY-CLIENT-124 (agent 124, Claude Opus 5.5 builder) — client purchase flow: the plans screen after a plan ends, while it is ending, next to another plan, and while a payment is overdue.

Tier: **T4** (client money path: which plan is current decides whether the client can buy, and what the screen says about charges). Mobile only; no backend change, so old app + new server and new app + old server both hold (new fields are read only when the purchase row carries them).

## Bs fixed (each with a test that fails on main)

**B-MC-1 — a client whose plan ended can never start it again.**
Story: a client on the $49/month plan ends it (or it ends after failed payments); once it has ended they open Coaching plans to start again, and that plan shows "Current plan", greyed out, with "Renews <a past date>", so they cannot buy it. On iOS this is the only buy surface; on Android the paywall's Subscribe also lands here.
Why: `clientPaymentsApi.getPaymentStatus()` fell back to the newest `canceled` purchase even with `entitlement_active=false`, and the screen marks `package_id === pkg.id` as current.
Fix: only a purchase with access (or a past-due one, whose fix is a card update) is current. A canceled row with no access is history.

**B-MC-2 — a plan the client ended still says "Renews <date>".**
Story: a client chooses End my plan; Your plans says "Ends on Nov 2", and the Current plan card right below still says "Renews Nov 2, 2026".
Fix: `currentPlanLine()` — cancel at period end, or canceled with access left: "Ends <date>. Nothing more is charged."; trialing: "Trial ends <date>" (from the row's `trial_ends_at`, the state was `none` before); one-time with an end: "Access until <date>"; past due: "The last payment did not go through." (was "Past due — see banner above", and that legacy banner never renders).

## Us fixed

- **U-MC-3** Each plan is its own subscription, so buying a second plan does not replace a renewing one. Other plans now say "<Plan> keeps renewing alongside this plan. To switch, end <Plan> in Your plans first." (hidden when the current plan is ending or one-time).
- **U-MC-4** A past-due plan in Your plans said "message your coach about the payment" (the coach cannot change a client's card). On the plans screen it now says "To keep this plan, choose Update card" and has an Update card action that opens the native card screen (`UpdateCard`, autostart), which also pays the open invoice. The routes are not flag-gated. Without the prop (any other caller) the old copy stays.
- **U-MC-5** The More stack hides headers, so Coaching plans had no back control (iOS edge swipe only). It now shows Back when there is a screen to return to (none when opened from another tab, where the tab bar stays).
- More > Membership description "Your access and coaching tier" -> "Your plan, payments and access" (that is where plans are managed).
- Membership "How access works" said "To pause, change tier, or cancel, message your coach directly"; a renewing plan can be ended in Coaching plans, so the copy says so.

## Files
- `src/api/clientPaymentsApi.ts` — getPaymentStatus derivation; optional `cancel_at_period_end`, `access_expires_at` on the status; purchase status union gains `trialing`, `unpaid`.
- `src/screens/client/ClientPackagesScreen.tsx` — `currentPlanLine`, second-plan notice, Update card into Your plans.
- `src/components/purchase/YourPlansPanel.tsx` — optional `onUpdateCard`, past-due line and action.
- `src/screens/client/MembershipScreen.tsx`, `src/screens/client/MoreScreen.tsx` — copy only.
- `src/__tests__/moneyClient124.test.tsx` — new: real clientPaymentsApi + ClientPackagesScreen, only HTTP mocked.

## Tests
- B-MC-1: `getPaymentStatus reports no current plan for a canceled purchase without access`; `the plans screen lets the client start the ended plan again` (main: state `canceled`, package `pkg-monthly`, button disabled "Current plan").
- B-MC-2: `cancel at period end reads "Ends <date>. Nothing more is charged."` (main: "Renews Nov 2, 2026").
- Regression: a live plan stays current and an older ended row does not override it.
- U-MC-3, U-MC-4, U-MC-5 cases.
- Lane ci/MONEY-CLIENT-124-1 (main + this spec only), run 37518049844: 6 of 6 fail on main (B-MC-1: state `canceled` instead of `none`; two "Current plan" texts on the ended plan; B-MC-2: no Ends line).

## C (no fix)
- C-MC-1 Receipts: no in-app receipt list; Stripe emails the receipt only when the live account's "Successful payments" customer email is on (owner setting, no code).
- C-MC-2 Purchase copy says a plan "appears in Membership"; Membership links to Coaching plans (one more tap), where Your plans lives.
- C-MC-3 iOS feature paywall says "Your coach manages your access" with Message your coach and no link to Coaching plans (deliberate 3.1.1 posture); a lapsed iOS client re-buys from More > Membership > View coaching plans.
- C (edge, deferred to 10k clients) an `unpaid` purchase with no access is not shown as current (same as main).

Size: 352 changed lines (6 files, 157 non-test).

Fix: `getPaymentStatus()` no longer falls back to a canceled purchase with no access.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#402 @ 927547f531fd6069e32114521b8da279cc3fed1e — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

AUD-SOL-MONEY-124, agent 124. A 0 / B 1 / C 0.

**B-402-1 — successful End / Keep actions leave the new charge summary at the old state.**

Normal-user story: a client taps **End my plan**, confirms, and gets a successful “will not renew” receipt, but **Current plan** below still says “Renews”; tapping **Keep my plan** similarly leaves “Nothing more is charged” underneath a plan that renews again. The second-plan renewal warning also keeps the pre-action state. ([ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:333,341,431–438](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/927547f531fd6069e32114521b8da279cc3fed1e/src%2Fscreens%2Fclient%2FClientPackagesScreen.tsx))

Cause: `YourPlansPanel.runAction` updates and reloads only its own `plans`; the parent retains its separately loaded `status`, and the changed panel invocation has no action-completed callback. This is the ordinary same-screen flow, not a race or an unusual server response. ([YourPlansPanel.tsx:211–251](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/927547f531fd6069e32114521b8da279cc3fed1e/src%2Fcomponents%2Fpurchase%2FYourPlansPanel.tsx), [ClientPackagesScreen.tsx:197–223,333](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/927547f531fd6069e32114521b8da279cc3fed1e/src%2Fscreens%2Fclient%2FClientPackagesScreen.tsx))

Requested fix: after a confirmed cancel or resume, refresh or reconcile the parent payment status too, so Current plan, purchase gating, and the second-plan warning agree with Your plans without requiring pull-to-refresh or leaving the screen. Add the ordinary End → summary and Keep → summary regressions to this fix. ([Reviewed integration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/927547f531fd6069e32114521b8da279cc3fed1e/src%2Fscreens%2Fclient%2FClientPackagesScreen.tsx))

Evidence: PR-head [Typecheck, lint, test is green](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37518931403/job/112458959337). One additional [targeted audit lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37520316119) is **queued**, so no passing or failing probe result is claimed; the finding follows directly from the disconnected parent/child state above. The cancel probe controls only HTTP replies, completes a normal successful cancel, verifies the server purchase now has `cancel_at_period_end=true`, and expects the summary to stop saying “Renews.” The launched Keep probe has an incorrect intermediate currency/cadence expectation; it is not evidence. The corrected reproduction is saved at `ops/aud-124/AUD-SOL-MONEY-124/m402-action-summary-probe-corrected.patch`, with no second lane push. No local npm/jest/tsc/build, no production or live payment calls, no PR-branch push. Independent review; no other lens's round comment or notes read.

FIX ROUND 2 (MONEY-CLIENT-124, agent 124) — growth-project-mobile#402 @ 6d66ea2bb19de2d4826ac454fae56521c8f70cca: B-402-1 (Sol) and B-402-2 (Opus) fixed — READY FOR RE-REVIEW

Built by R-MONEY-FINISH-124 (agent 124). One commit on 927547f5, 3 files (+102 / -6), PR now 454 changed lines (1,500 cap). Delta to review: 927547f5..6d66ea2b.

**B-402-1 (Sol, comment 6024062034)**: after End my plan or Keep my plan succeeds, Current plan, the buy buttons and the second-plan notice now follow the new state on the same screen.
- `YourPlansPanel` takes an optional `onPlanChanged`, called after a successful cancel or resume (after its own re-read). `ClientPackagesScreen` passes a callback that re-reads payment status only (`getPaymentStatus` -> `setStatus`) and refreshes entitlement. It does not bump `plansTick`, so the "will not renew" receipt in Your plans stays. Other callers without the prop are unchanged.

**B-402-2 (Opus, comment 6024124194)**: the Ends line under Current plan used `access_expires_at` (period end + 24 h on every paid recurring row), so it read Nov 3 under a Your plans line reading Nov 2.
- `currentPlanLine` now uses `current_period_end` first and falls back to `access_expires_at` only when there is no period end. "Access until" (one-time plans) is unchanged.

**Tests** (src/__tests__/moneyClient124.test.tsx; real screen, panel and clientPaymentsApi, HTTP mocked only):
- B-MC-2 row is now realistic (`access_expires_at` = `current_period_end` + 24 h) and asserts Current plan "Ends Nov 2, 2030" and Your plans "November 2, 2030".
- New: End my plan -> Current plan goes from "Renews" to "Ends ... Nothing more is charged.", the second-plan notice disappears, the receipt survives. Keep my plan -> Current plan goes to "Renews", the notice returns.
- Failing on 927547f5 (lane https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37522417188, 927547f5 + this spec only): 3 failed / 7 passed. B-MC-2 received "Ends Nov 3, 2030" (B-402-2); End received "Renews Nov 2, 2030" after a completed cancel (B-402-1); Keep failed at its first assertion on the Nov 3 date (B-402-2), so its post-action check is proven by the End case's mechanism.
- Fix head before push: lane https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37521568409 (tsc + every src jest suite) green.

CI at this head: Typecheck, lint, test green https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37522384095/job/112470796274 ; CodeQL green.

B/U/C this round: B 2 fixed (B-402-1, B-402-2), U 0, C 0 new (C-402-1 from the Opus verdict stays a follow-up ticket). Owner decision unchanged: D1 turn on Stripe live "Successful payments" customer emails (default yes, free, no code). No merge, deploy, production, Stripe, EAS or spend.
